description: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B MoE vision-language model via Ollama: fast local generalist, below the dense 27B on hard tasks.
notes: NOT INSTALLED: pull with `ollama pull qwen3.6:35b`. Download 23-24GB (35.5B MoE (A3B, ~3B active), Q4_K_M default tag), needs ~28GB RAM plus KV cache; fits the 48GB M4 Max. Library context 256K; limit set to 131072 because Ollama sizes context from VRAM (assumes OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH raised). No independent benchmark found; MoE with ~3B active set 0.3 below qwen3.6-27b dense, above gemma4:26b (5.0). Q4 quantization already accounted for. Latency estimated for M4 Max 48GB by scaling measured gemma4:26b (78 tok/s, ~4B active) by active-weight bytes; not measured. Thinking is on by default: pass think=false for fast answers. Active-parameter count assumed from the A3B tag name. Page checked 2026-10-25.
